artifacts.summary: 4-phase sequential verification-and-gap-closure plan for the system-defect discrimination contract: re-verify citations and fix an off-by-two citation range; extend Signal A by one empirically-evidenced instance (null/absent artifacts on a success status) explicitly marked as having no current detector; record the handoff-present branch's total absence of an artifacts shape check as a detection hole distinct from the three existing classes; document the two deliberately-excluded critical_paths candidates with guard-scope reasoning; final gate with line_count refresh. orchestrator-critical-paths.json verified correct as delivered and left unchanged.

memory_candidates.content: The ARTIFACTS_SHAPE_MISMATCH detector in scripts/orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh has exactly two firing arms -- (artifacts_length > 0 AND resolved path empty), and jq_artifact_failure (non-zero jq exit while resolving .artifacts[0].path/.type/.summary). A `null` or absent artifacts field satisfies NEITHER: `(.artifacts // []) | length` yields 0 and `.artifacts[0].path // ""` yields empty with exit 0, because jq's null[0] is null rather than an error. Only the bare-string-array form trips the detector, and it does so via the jq-failure arm (exit 5), not the length arm that the in-file header comment describes. Consequence: a handoff or return-meta emitting `artifacts: null` alongside a success status passes as clean with evidence_reason=NONE. Verify this empirically with the two one-line jq probes before reasoning about artifacts-shape coverage; the header comment alone will mislead you about which arm fires.
